verdict.rationale: A documentation framework could plausibly ship a natural-language or AI-assisted interface, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only a conventional command-based CLI (create, build, serve, versioning) and MDX authoring, with nothing showing operation through natural-language commands. Probes also found no llms.txt or markdown docs endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
